context_rules: No task may load src/App.jsx in full or the full assessment doc. Use appjsx-index.json line ranges and assessment-chunks/ only.

tasks.title: Code Cartography: index App.jsx pages
tasks.objective: Produce workspace/context/appjsx-index.json mapping each of the 18 pages to its line range, shared state/hooks, and imports, WITHOUT loading the whole file.

code_files: src/App.jsx (STRUCTURAL SCAN ONLY: grep for component/function/route boundaries, read in bounded chunks via sed/offset; never hold the full file in context)
forbidden_context: src/App.jsx (full file in context at once)

expected_output.summary_back_to_manager: Index of 18 pages with line ranges + shared state.

acceptance_criteria: All 18 pages listed with start/end line numbers
Each entry lists the shared state/hooks it reads and its imports
No step required loading the entire file into a single context

tasks.title: Enforce JWT on all API endpoints
tasks.objective: Add JWT verification middleware and apply it to every Express route that returns or mutates org data.

git.commit_msg: feat(security): enforce JWT on all API endpoints

expected_output.summary_back_to_manager: JWT middleware added + applied to N routes; pointer to diff.

acceptance_criteria: Every data-returning/mutating endpoint rejects requests without a valid JWT (401)
A valid token resolves to an authenticated identity used for org binding
No endpoint left unauthenticated except explicit public health checks

tasks.title: Tighten CORS to production allowlist
tasks.objective: Replace allow-all CORS with an env-driven allowlist; remove the 'tighten in production' TODO.

expected_output.summary_back_to_manager: CORS limited to env allowlist; TODO removed; pointer to diff.

acceptance_criteria: CORS rejects origins not in the configured allowlist
Allowlist is configurable via environment, not hard-coded
The 'allow all - tighten in production' comment/behavior is gone

tasks.title: Implement real org isolation
tasks.objective: Bind org isolation to the authenticated JWT identity (not just a request header) so a user can only access their own org's data.

git.commit_msg: feat(security): bind org isolation to auth identity

expected_output.summary_back_to_manager: Org scoping derived from token identity; cross-org access blocked.

acceptance_criteria: Org is resolved from the authenticated identity, not a client-supplied header alone
A request for another org's data is rejected (403)
All org-scoped queries are filtered by the authenticated org

tasks.title: Resolve background scheduler status
tasks.objective: Decide and implement: either deploy scheduler.js as a Render Background Worker (add render.yaml entry) or remove the dead code. Document the decision.

expected_output.summary_back_to_manager: Scheduler either wired as a worker or removed; decision documented.

acceptance_criteria: Either render.yaml defines the background worker OR scheduler.js and its references are removed
No dead/unreferenced scheduler code remains if the remove path was chosen
Decision and rationale recorded in the output file

tasks.title: Implement core correlation data-model entities
tasks.objective: Add BusinessProcess, Asset, DataObject, ThreatScenario, LegalObligation, ExecutiveOwner per the spec, with the documented key relationships and migrations.

expected_output.summary_back_to_manager: 6 entities + migrations added; relationships wired; pointer to diff.

acceptance_criteria: All six entities exist with the fields named in the data-model spec
Key relationships hold: Finding->Risk->BusinessProcess->FinancialImpact and BusinessProcess->Application->Asset
Migrations run cleanly against the existing PostgreSQL schema without breaking the 5 current tables

tasks.title: Expand Risk + Finding entities for correlation
tasks.objective: Extend Risk and Finding to carry business-process, data-object, threat-scenario, framework, financial, legal, and ownership linkage.

git.commit_msg: feat(model): correlation linkage on Risk and Finding

expected_output.summary_back_to_manager: Risk/Finding extended with linkage fields + migrations.

acceptance_criteria: Risk carries businessProcessId[], dataObjectIds[], threatScenarioId, frameworkMappings[], financialExposure, legalObligationId[], executiveOwner
Finding links to riskId/assetId/businessProcessId and supports repeat detection fields
Migrations run cleanly and preserve existing data

tasks.title: Build the correlation engine logic
tasks.objective: Implement the service that takes a technical finding and produces the executive narrative (process, data, threat, $ exposure, framework refs, legal obligations, owners, audit evidence).

git.commit_msg: feat: risk correlation engine service + API

expected_output.summary_back_to_manager: Engine endpoint returns full executive narrative for a finding.

acceptance_criteria: Given a finding, the engine returns: business process, data type, threat scenario, financial exposure, framework refs, legal obligations, owners, audit evidence requirement
Output matches the assessment's example narrative shape (e.g. CVE on NASCO -> Claims Adjudication -> $ exposure -> HIPAA/NIST/CIS refs)
Exposed via an authenticated, org-scoped API endpoint

Displays business process, data involvement, threat scenario, financial exposure, regulatory obligations, and ownership
